full_prompt_en: A square photograph records a hand painting a dense white-on-black folk-art scene. The painted surface fills nearly the entire frame. At the right center, a real warm-brown hand enters from the lower right and holds a thin brush with a pale tip just above the picture. Its skin and brush are the only naturalistic color against the nearly monochrome artwork. The drawing is organized in horizontal bands. At the top, a narrow border of repeated white ornament runs above a black night sky sprinkled with small white dots and one larger round moon. Wavy parallel hills separate the sky from a densely populated village. Below, many tiny pale houses with pitched roofs, round-canopied trees, trunks, fences, and clusters of little marks form several rows across the middle. Fine dots and short lines fill most spaces between them, leaving little bare black. In the lower middle, a dark horizontal water band opens between the village and a broad decorative lower border. A small boat carries a few tiny white figures at left, and another small shape rests on the water farther right. At the very bottom, rows of triangular, zigzag, dot, and curved white motifs make a thick continuous frame. The hand hovers just above the waterline, emphasizing the painting's meticulous scale. White marks range from hairline strokes to dense stipple and filled shapes; their different densities build gray-looking texture without any gray pigment. Light on the hand is soft and warm, while the artwork is evenly illuminated so every repeated mark remains legible. The composition is crowded but carefully tiered, with the calm black water stripe offering a pause between the intricate village and patterned border.
full_prompt_zh: 一张方形照片记录一只手在黑底上绘制繁密白色民间图案。绘画表面几乎填满整幅。右侧中部，一只真实的暖棕色手从右下进入，握着细画笔，浅色笔尖悬在画面上方。皮肤与画笔是近乎单色作品前唯一自然主义色彩。绘画按横向色带组织。顶部，重复白色装饰组成一道窄边框；其下黑色夜空撒满小白点，并有一枚较大圆月。波浪状平行山线把天空与拥挤村落隔开。下方，许多极小的浅色尖顶屋、圆冠树、树干、栅栏和成簇小记号横向排列在中部数层里。细点与短线填满大部分空隙，几乎没有裸露黑底。下中部，一道深暗横向水域在村落与宽阔装饰底边之间打开。左侧一条小船载着几名微小白色人物，右边更远处水上还有另一小形。最底部，三角、锯齿、点和弯线的重复白纹组成厚而连续的边饰。手悬在水线略上方，强调画作精细的尺度。白色笔迹从发丝细线到密集点彩与填色形态不等；不同密度在没有灰色颜料的情况下做出灰调般肌理。手上的光柔和而温暖，作品则受均匀照明，每个重复记号都可辨。构图拥挤却分层仔细，安静黑水带在繁密村落与纹样边框之间留下一次停顿。
style_prompt_en: Folk-art line painting uses a dark ground and densely repeated pale marks to build an entire visual field. Thin strokes, stippled dots, filled small shapes, wavy bands, and geometric border patterns sit in clearly separated horizontal registers. Differences in white-mark density create gray-looking tonal variation without smooth shading. Small motifs repeat with slight handmade irregularity, producing rhythm rather than mechanical tiling. A few broader unmarked dark strips give the eye rest between packed sections. Even illumination preserves the clarity of every contour; shallow stacked space replaces deep perspective. The result is intricate and communal in feeling, with ornamental detail held together by strong banded structure.
style_prompt_zh: 民间线描绘画以深色底和密集重复浅色笔迹建立整个视觉色域。细线、点彩、填实小形、波浪色带与几何边饰纹样处在清楚分开的横向层里。白色笔迹密度变化制造灰调般明暗，却不使用光滑阴影。小纹样带着轻微手工不齐地重复，形成节奏而非机械平铺。几条较宽未着墨暗带让视线在拥挤区域之间休息。均匀照明保留每处轮廓的清晰；浅而堆叠的空间取代深透视。整体精细而有共同体气息，装饰细节由有力的分带结构收在一起。
theme_en: A hand adding white detail to a densely patterned night village painting
theme_zh: 一只手正为纹样繁密的夜村绘画添上白色细节
name: Warli painting
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
